title: Forgiveness for the Offender, Triumphant in Christ

questions.question: Paul made up his mind not to make another ____ visit to them.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 2:1 (ESV): "For I made up my mind not to make another painful visit to you."

questions.question: For if I cause you pain, who is there to make me ____ but the one whom I have pained?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 2:2 (ESV): "For if I cause you pain, who is there to make me glad but the one whom I have pained?"

questions.question: Paul wrote as he did so that when he came he might not suffer pain from those who should have made him ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 2:3 (ESV): "And I wrote as I did, so that when I came I might not suffer pain from those who should have made me rejoice,"

questions.question: For I wrote to you out of much affliction and anguish of heart and with many tears, not to cause you pain but to let you know the abundant ____ that I have for you.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 2:4 (ESV): "For I wrote to you out of much affliction and anguish of heart and with many tears, not to cause you pain but to let you know the abundant love that I have for you."

questions.question: For such a one (who has caused pain), this ____ by the majority is enough.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 2:6 (ESV): "For such a one, this punishment by the majority is enough,"

questions.question: Instead of further punishment, Paul says they should rather turn to ____ and comfort him.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 2:7 (ESV): "so you should rather turn to forgive and comfort him, or he may be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow."

questions.question: Why did they need to forgive and comfort the man?
options: Or he may be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow
So that he might immediately be restored to eldership
Because the law of Moses requires it
Because he had made full financial restitution
questions.correctAnswer: Or he may be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 2:7 (ESV): "so you should rather turn to forgive and comfort him, or he may be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow."

questions.question: So I beg you to reaffirm your ____ for him.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 2:8 (ESV): "So I beg you to reaffirm your love for him."

questions.question: Paul forgave anyone they forgave, doing it in the presence of Christ, so that we would not be outwitted by ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 2:10-11 (ESV): "Anyone whom you forgive, I also forgive... so that we would not be outwitted by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his designs."

questions.question: Why would Satan outwit them if they did not forgive?
options: For we are not ignorant of his designs
Because unforgiveness is the greatest sin
Satan prowls like a roaring lion
It would cause a permanent schism in the church
questions.correctAnswer: For we are not ignorant of his designs
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 2:11 (ESV): "so that we would not be outwitted by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his designs."

questions.question: When Paul came to Troas to preach the gospel, even though a door was opened for him in the Lord, his spirit was not at rest because he did not find whom there?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 2:12-13 (ESV): "When I came to Troas to preach the gospel of Christ, even though a door was opened for me in the Lord, my spirit was not at rest because I did not find my brother Titus there."

questions.question: Because his spirit was not at rest in Troas, where did Paul go?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 2:13 (ESV): "So I took leave of them and went on to Macedonia."

questions.question: Paul thanks God, who in Christ always leads us in triumphal procession, and through us spreads the ____ of the knowledge of him everywhere.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 2:14 (ESV): "But thanks be to God, who in Christ always leads us in triumphal procession, and through us spreads the fragrance of the knowledge of him everywhere."

questions.question: For we are the aroma of Christ to God among those who are being saved and among those who are ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 2:15 (ESV): "For we are the aroma of Christ to God among those who are being saved and among those who are perishing,"

questions.question: To the perishing, we are a fragrance from death to death, to the saved, a fragrance from ____ to ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 2:16 (ESV): "to one a fragrance from death to death, to the other a fragrance from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?"

key_verse_text: But thanks be to God, who in Christ always leads us in triumphal procession, and through us spreads the fragrance of the knowledge of him everywhere. For we are the aroma of Christ to God among those who are being saved and among those who are perishing,
